_about: Every number used by .github/scripts/water_atlas_riparian.py. Change a value here and rerun the workflow 'Riparian pump-irrigation potential' to reproduce or test a different assumption. See METHOD.md.

riveratlas.name: RiverATLAS v1.0 (HydroATLAS)
riveratlas.cite: Linke, S., Lehner, B., Ouellet Dallaire, C., et al. (2019). Global hydro-environmental sub-basin and river reach characteristics at high spatial resolution. Scientific Data 6, 283. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-019-0300-6

dem.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (2021 release)
dem.cite: European Space Agency (2021). Copernicus Global Digital Elevation Model GLO-30. Distributed by OpenTopography. https://doi.org/10.5069/G9028PQB

landcover.name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200
landcover.cite: Zanaga, D., Van De Kerchove, R., Daems, D., et al. (2022). ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7254221

protected.name: Protected areas with mapped boundaries (WDPA and state records), Nigeria Forest Reserves Atlas

states.name: State boundaries (geoBoundaries ADM1), as used by the atlas

rivers._min_dry_flow_m3s: A reach counts as flowing all year if its lowest long-term monthly natural flow (RiverATLAS dis_m3_pmn) is at least this many m3/s.
rivers._exclude_lake_pct: Reaches whose local catchment is at least this % lake or reservoir (lka_pc_cse) are treated as reservoir shoreline, not river, and get no strip.
rivers._snap_to_water_m: Open water mapped by WorldCover within this distance of a RiverATLAS line is taken as the real channel; the line is used only where no water is visible.
rivers._visible_ratio: If a reach has at least this many snapped water pixels per line pixel, its channel is the mapped water only.

_levels: low = cautious, central = best estimate, high = optimistic. landcover: classes that may be cropped (tree cover, built-up land, water and protected areas are never counted). efficiency: share of pumped water that reaches the crop roots. kc: FAO-56 crop coefficient at peak growth. reserve: share of the lowest monthly flow left in the river for the environment, people, livestock and fishing.
effective_rain: FAO dependable rain: Peff = 0.8P - 25 if P > 75 mm/month, else max(0, 0.6P - 10)
